examples.english: And whilst I was marvelling at the trees, and was looking at them, and at the fruit that was on them, behold four young men appeared in the distance, and their forms were goodly, and they were dressed in fine skin garments which, as it were, covered all their bodies.
And one of them appeared from out of the herd,
examples.source: History of Eustathius and Theopiste part 1
